note: Off-campus sites that count as HOME for the designated home team, keyed by canonical team slug -> list of Repole info-city strings (the '@ City ST' value with the '@ ' stripped). A Repole game whose info city matches the designated home team's entry here is a home game, not neutral. Every other '@ City ST' game is neutral. parse-repole.mjs prints the full (homeTeam, city) frequency table so new pairs can be reviewed into this file rather than guessed.
